prompt:
We need the executable migration architecture for the Chicago VCF fleet, not a narrative design. Implement the single-file plain-JDK client VcfMigrationPlanner.java. It must accept exactly three command-line arguments — the estate inventory path, the pinned compatibility snapshot path, and an output path — and write one deterministic UTF-8 JSON migration plan to the output path. Do not add dependencies or additional production source files.

Before changing code, use the harness's genuine network research tools to consult current, reachable Broadcom-published VMware Cloud Foundation compatibility/interoperability material and supported upgrade-path guidance for the 5.2.x-to-9.1 path. Also inspect the VCF Installer OpenAPI specification published in vmware/vcf-api-specs at tag 9.1.0.0. Record the exact titles and URLs you actually consulted in the plan's top-level researchConsulted array. Do not treat the pinned snapshot as a substitute for live research. If current sources differ from the fixture, keep the plan aligned to the pinned snapshot as the reproducible compatibility contract and mention the discrepancy in your final summary.

The supplied estate inventory describes a workload domain that was added while the fleet was at 5.2.2 and now remains at 5.2.2 after the management domain reached 9.1.0.0. Produce the ordered migration for that workload domain only. Every inventory component must appear exactly once with its current version, target version, action, and technical gates. The management domain and every one of its components must remain unchanged and must never appear in an upgrade step. Use only supported release edges and the exact component targets, gates, and step order from fixtures/compatibility-snapshot.json.

The JSON document itself must be both (1) a valid SddcSpec according to specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json from tag 9.1.0.0 and (2) a valid migration plan according to schemas/migration-plan.schema.json. Populate the SddcSpec fields from installerEnvelope in the estate fixture; the migration-plan fields coexist at the top level. Include researchConsulted as additional top-level provenance.

TestMain.java is the protected acceptance harness. It invokes your client, validates the emitted document against the installer specification's own SddcSpec schema before performing any migration checks, then validates and reconciles the plan against the protected fixture and pinned snapshot. Run it with: java TestMain.java. Do not modify TestMain.java, fixtures/, schemas/, or specifications/.

research.interface: VCF 5.2.2 workload-domain migration to VCF 9.1.0.0 and VCF Installer SddcSpec 9.1.0.0
